_note: WHAT THE PLAYER CAN DO ON HIS TURN (group N, 2026-10-03; Yannick, after Baldur's Gate 3: the actions gathered by category in a wheel, a target chosen explicitly, the chance to hit and the damage shown before the blow). One row an action and one a category, in the wheel's order. A new weapon or spell is a row here: 'kind' is what the turn does (strike, cast, wait), 'weapon' what it strikes with ('held': the sword in his hand, or his fists; 'bow': the bow on his back), 'needs' what he must carry or know for it to be offered at all. core/rules/action_rules.gd reads it; the wheel is drawn by FightHud._draw_wheel (view/fight_hud.gd).
_categories_note: The wheel's segments, clockwise from the top. 'items' is there before there is an item to put in it, and is drawn empty. An item will take more than a row: a 'use' kind, which the fight (DuelRules, DuelSystem) does not know yet, and what it does to whom - the work of the inventory's consumables, later.
